name: agent-guide
body: Agent guide: the embedded `AGENTS.md` seed content and its verbatim write for all three scaffolding forms — the shared deck-author guide written by `kalide init` and `kalide init <path>` (agent-authoring) and the library/template-author guide written by `kalide init-library` (library-agent-guide, library-guide-layout). Realised by the scaffold package's embedded seed and writers (internal/scaffold) and announced by the CLI handlers (internal/cli), evidenced today by Init, writeHelloSeed, InitExternal, InitLibrary and DefaultThemeCSS; the guide file(s) themselves and any new library-form read helper (mirroring mustReadSeed/DefaultThemeCSS) are declared planned at plan time.
